title: health-food
text: This project investigates physical measurements and health metrics from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), provided by the primer.data R package.

title: health-food
text:
Ultra-Processed Food Consumption Over Time
Research from NHANES dietary recall surveys tracks the proportion of daily calories coming from ultra-processed foods (such as packaged snacks, sugary beverages, and ready-to-eat meals) among Americans.










Majority of Calories: Ultra-processed foods contribute over 57% of daily calories consumed by US adults.
Steady Rise: Between 2001–2002 and 2017–2018, the share of daily energy from ultra-processed food grew by 3.5 percentage points.

title: NHANES Health Insights
text: The National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) assesses the health and nutritional status of adults and children across the United States.

title: NHANES Health Insights
text:
Obesity Rates Over Time
Beyond individual age trajectories, national health surveys track how adult obesity prevalence has shifted across recent decades.










Rising Trend: Between 1999–2000 and 2017–2018, the US adult obesity rate increased from 30.5% to over 42%.
Recent Leveling: Rates remained above 41% entering 2020, highlighting continuing public health challenges.
